# Stack Overflow

4 endpoints, all GET. Base URL `https://www.socialcrawl.dev`, auth header `x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY`.

**Credit costs:** 4 standard (1 credit) - the exact cost is in each endpoint heading below.

## GET /v1/stackoverflow/question - 1 credit (standard)

Returns one Stack Overflow question by its number: title (`post.content.text`), link, the full body as plain text (`post.ext.description`), tags, the asker with their avatar, score, views, answer count and the time it was asked. `post.ext.stackoverflow` adds whether it is answered, the accepted answer's id (read the answers with GET /v1/stackoverflow/question/answers), the last activity and edit times, why it was closed when it is, the asker's reputation and the content licence. A number Stack Overflow does not know answers 404 and is not charged.

**Use when** Use it with a question number or link when you need the whole question and whether it has an accepted answer.
**Cost** cache 600 s · multi-source (billed once)
**Paging** none

**Query params**

- `id` (optional, string) - The question's number, the digits in its link: stackoverflow.com/questions/11227809/... is 11227809. Every row of GET /v1/stackoverflow/search carries it as post.id. Send id or url. · e.g. `11227809`
- `url` (optional, string) - The question's link on stackoverflow.com, for example https://stackoverflow.com/questions/11227809 (each search row's post.url). Send id or url.

**Constraints**

- Provide at least one of `id`, `url`.

**Response** `Post` object at `data`, `{ computed, post }` ([full schema](schemas/Post.md))

| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `post.content.text` | Post caption, description, or text content |
| `post.id` | Platform-specific post ID… |
| `post.published_at` | Post creation timestamp as an ISO 8601 UTC string. |
| `post.url` | Direct URL to the post on the source platform |
| `post.author.username` | Author username |
| `computed.content_category` | Keyword-classified content category… |

+13 more (types in the full schema): `computed` {engagement_rate, estimated_reach, language, save_rate}; `post.author` {avatar_url, display_name}; `post.engagement` {comments, likes, views}; `post.ext` {description, stackoverflow, tags}; `post.flags` {deleted}. Never filled: `post.author.verified`, `post.content.duration_seconds`, `post.content.media_urls`, `post.content.thumbnail_url`, `post.engagement.saves`, `post.engagement.shares`.

```bash
curl -G "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/stackoverflow/question" \
  --data-urlencode "id=11227809" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

## GET /v1/stackoverflow/question/answers - 1 credit (standard)

Returns the answers to one Stack Overflow question, 30 a page by default and up to 100, for up to 25 pages, each in the Comment shape: the answer's id and link, the question it answers (`comment.post_id`), the full answer as plain text (`comment.text`), the author with their avatar, score (`comment.engagement.likes`) and the time it was posted. `comment.ext.stackoverflow.is_accepted` is true on the answer the asker accepted; it also carries the last activity and edit times, the author's reputation and the content licence. Sort by votes (default), activity or creation date, highest or newest first. A question with no answers returns an empty list.

**Use when** you want to collect the solutions to a question and pick out the accepted or highest-voted answer.
**Cost** cache 300 s · multi-source (billed once)
**Paging** page (native `page`) · 30/page by default, max 100; set with `limit` · depth unknown · N items ≈ ceil(N/30) x 1 credits

**Query params**

- `id` (optional, string) - The question's number, the digits in its link: stackoverflow.com/questions/11227809/... is 11227809. Every row of GET /v1/stackoverflow/search carries it as post.id. Send id or url. · e.g. `11227809`
- `url` (optional, string) - The question's link on stackoverflow.com, for example https://stackoverflow.com/questions/11227809 (each search row's post.url). Send id or url.
- `sort` (optional, enum: votes | activity | creation) - votes (default), activity or creation, highest or newest first.
- `page` (optional, integer, 1-25) - Page number from 1 to 25. Prefer the universal cursor parameter.
- `limit` (optional, integer, 1-100) - Rows per page, 1 to 100. Defaults to 30.
- `since` (optional, string) - Rows published from this date: YYYY-MM-DD (midnight UTC) or ISO 8601. Rows older than it are left off each page. This list is not in date order, so the walk does not stop at the date: keep following `next_cursor`, and each page costs what a page costs even when every row on it is filtered out. Aliases: [date window](api-overview.md#date-window-since-until).
- **Shared controls** `max_pages` (1-50) → [walks](api-overview.md#search-filters-and-multi-page-walks); `max_items` (1-5000) · `max_credits` (1-100000) → [one-call walks](api-overview.md#get-more-in-one-call-max_items-max_credits-max_pages); `until` → [date window](api-overview.md#date-window-since-until)

**Constraints**

- Provide at least one of `id`, `url`.

**Response** `CommentList` rows at `data.items[]`, each `{ comment, computed }` ([full schema](schemas/CommentList.md))

| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `comment.text` | Comment body. |
| `comment.id` | Platform-specific comment ID (always a string) |
| `comment.published_at` | Comment creation timestamp as an ISO 8601 UTC string. |
| `comment.url` | Direct URL to the comment on the source platform |
| `comment.author.username` | Comment author username (null when tombstoned) |
| `comment.post_id` | ID of the post this comment belongs to |

+9 more (types in the full schema): `comment.author` {avatar_url, display_name}; `comment.engagement` {likes}; `comment.ext` {stackoverflow}; `comment.flags` {deleted}; `computed` {language}; `computed.country` {confidence, source, value}. Never filled: `comment.author.verified`, `comment.engagement.replies`, `comment.parent_id`. Page-level: `data.comment_recency`, `data.dropped`, `data.empty_reason`, `data.empty_reason_note`, `data.walk`.

```bash
curl -G "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/stackoverflow/question/answers" \
  --data-urlencode "id=11227809" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

## GET /v1/stackoverflow/question/comments - 1 credit (standard)

Returns the comments posted on one Stack Overflow question (not on its answers), newest first, 30 a page by default and up to 100, for up to 25 pages: each comment's id and link, the text as plain text, the author with their avatar, score (`comment.engagement.likes`), whether it was edited (`comment.ext.is_edited`) and the time it was posted. `comment.ext.stackoverflow` adds the author's reputation and the content licence. A question with no comments returns an empty list.

**Use when** you want to read the clarifications and follow-up remarks posted under a question.
**Cost** cache 300 s · multi-source (billed once)
**Paging** page (native `page`) · 30/page by default, max 100; set with `limit` · depth unknown · N items ≈ ceil(N/30) x 1 credits

- `id` (optional, string) - The question's number, the digits in its link: stackoverflow.com/questions/11227809/... is 11227809. Every row of GET /v1/stackoverflow/search carries it as post.id. Send id or url. · e.g. `11227809`
- `url` (optional, string) - The question's link on stackoverflow.com, for example https://stackoverflow.com/questions/11227809 (each search row's post.url). Send id or url.
- `page` (optional, integer, 1-25) - Page number from 1 to 25. Prefer the universal cursor parameter.
- `limit` (optional, integer, 1-100) - Rows per page, 1 to 100. Defaults to 30.
- `since` (optional, string) - Rows published from this date: YYYY-MM-DD (midnight UTC) or ISO 8601. Rows older than it are left off each page. This list is not in date order, so the walk does not stop at the date: keep following `next_cursor`, and each page costs what a page costs even when every row on it is filtered out. Aliases: [date window](api-overview.md#date-window-since-until).

## GET /v1/stackoverflow/search - 1 credit (standard)

Returns Stack Overflow questions matching search terms, optionally narrowed to tags, 30 a page by default and up to 100, for up to 25 pages. Each question is a Post: the question number (`post.id`, the id GET /v1/stackoverflow/question takes), title (`post.content.text`), link, the body as plain text (`post.ext.description`), tags (`post.ext.tags`), the asker, score (`post.engagement.likes`), views and answer count (`post.engagement.comments`). `post.ext.stackoverflow` adds whether the question is answered, the accepted answer's id, the last activity and edit times and the asker's reputation. Sort by relevance (default), votes, activity or creation date, newest or highest first. Pass the returned cursor for the next page.

**Use when** you want to find the questions developers ask about a library, an error or a topic, then read one in full.
**Cost** cache 120 s · multi-source (billed once)
**Paging** page (native `page`) · 30/page by default, max 100; set with `limit` · depth unknown · N items ≈ ceil(N/30) x 1 credits

**Query params**

- `query` (required) - Search terms, 1 to 300 characters, for example pandas groupby. · e.g. `pandas groupby`
- `tagged` (optional, string) - Tags the questions must all carry, separated by semicolons or commas, for example python;pandas. · e.g. `python`
- `sort` (optional, enum: relevance | votes | activity | creation) - relevance (default), votes, activity or creation, highest or newest first.
- `page` (optional, integer, 1-25) - Page number from 1 to 25. Prefer the universal cursor parameter.
- `limit` (optional, integer, 1-100) - Rows per page, 1 to 100. Defaults to 30.
- `since` (optional, string) - Rows published from this date: YYYY-MM-DD (midnight UTC) or ISO 8601. Rows older than it are left off each page. This list is not in date order, so the walk does not stop at the date: keep following `next_cursor`, and each page costs what a page costs even when every row on it is filtered out. Aliases: [date window](api-overview.md#date-window-since-until).
- **Shared controls** `max_pages` (1-50) → [walks](api-overview.md#search-filters-and-multi-page-walks); `max_items` (1-5000) · `max_credits` (1-100000) → [one-call walks](api-overview.md#get-more-in-one-call-max_items-max_credits-max_pages); `until` → [date window](api-overview.md#date-window-since-until)

**Response** `PostList` rows at `data.items[]`, each `{ computed, post }` ([full schema](schemas/PostList.md))

| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `post.content.text` | Post caption, description, or text content |
| `post.id` | Platform-specific post ID… |
| `post.published_at` | Post creation timestamp as an ISO 8601 UTC string. |
| `post.url` | Direct URL to the post on the source platform |
| `post.author.username` | Author username |
| `computed.content_category` | Keyword-classified content category… |

+13 more (types in the full schema): `computed` {engagement_rate, estimated_reach, language, save_rate}; `post.author` {avatar_url, display_name}; `post.engagement` {comments, likes, views}; `post.ext` {description, stackoverflow, tags}; `post.flags` {deleted}. Never filled: `post.author.verified`, `post.content.duration_seconds`, `post.content.media_urls`, `post.content.thumbnail_url`, `post.engagement.saves`, `post.engagement.shares`. Page-level: `data.dropped`, `data.empty_reason`, `data.empty_reason_note`, `data.walk`.
